projectDescription: A 12-chapter, fully annotated interactive textbook for building a modern LLaMA-style language model from scratch using Python and PyTorch.
keyFeatures: 12-chapter structured curriculum from zero to working GPT
Every line of code annotated with WHAT and WHY
LLaMA 3-style architecture: RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, Pre-Norm
Full training pipeline: AdamW, cosine warmup, mixed precision, gradient accumulation
Inference engine with KV cache, temperature, top-k/p, beam search
5-year-old analogies plus rigorous math and worked numeric examples
Runnable main.py with both tiny (CPU) and small (GPU) configurations
BPE tokenizer walkthrough matching GPT-4 algorithm
publicApiSurface: GPTConfig — model hyperparameters (vocab_size, d_model, num_heads, num_layers, max_seq_len)
GPT — complete 124M parameter decoder-only Transformer model
MultiHeadAttention — scaled dot-product attention with causal mask and RoPE
RMSNorm — root mean square layer normalization
TextDataset — PyTorch dataset for next-token prediction
train — full training loop with mixed precision
generate_text — inference with temperature, top-k, top-p, beam search
